basis_by_decision.ACCOMPLISHMENTS-SAN-DIEGO-STATE: SDSU institutional history establishes two pre-Mountain-West Division I regular-season conference titles (PCAA shares in 1977 and 1978), two pre-MW conference tournament titles (PCAA 1976 and WAC 1985), and nine Mountain West regular-season plus seven Mountain West tournament titles through the completed 2025-26 season. The in-scope totals are therefore 11 regular-season and 9 tournament championships; the existing NCAA/Final Four/runner-up fields already match.
